hooks.name: AGRILENS C: quality gate before commit, approval before push
hooks.description: Before a shell command runs: a git commit is blocked if the AGRILENS quality gate fails on the staged change; git push, gh release create and the OTA publisher require explicit user approval.

action.command: python -c "import os,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();t=os.path.join(r,'tools','governance','agl_governance.py');sys.exit(0 if not os.path.exists(t) else (2 if subprocess.run([sys.executable,t,'hook-pretool'],stdin=sys.stdin,cwd=r).returncode==3 else 0))"
